name: Saionji Seri
source:
At only 14-years-old, Seri is a genius in his first year of high school. He has a femininely cute appearance, but he's actually quite cold and has a sharp tongue. As a result, Seri is considered to be hard to get close to, let alone approach. A cool customer, nothing truly amuses him and nothing really fazes him. Due to his incredible intellect, he has an insufferable persona and tends to make fun of everyone around him. 

Seri's conduct and views are primarily shaped by his highly logical mind and merit-based formulae. His thought processes even extends to love, which he believes to be pointless and stupid. Seri often asserts that in the end, everything can be explained logically.
